title: Simply awesome!
body:
This app is just perfect to help you stay on track. It lets you see your progress on all kinds of things with nice and simple interface + visual representation of data is very good.
I would recommend it to anyone.
author: coffeegrain

title: Best of its kind
body:
This is the most productive app available. It's amazing how much more I get done. Developers regulary update it, it started as very basic and grew to what it is now - irreplaceable.

Best paid app I own. Worth every penny :)
author: Nayas

title: Great, it helps a lot!
body: This is what I was looking for! Great app to track my goals, habits...keep up the good work!
